name: Sawano Masaya
source:
A college student living alone away from his parents.
Having lived in a boys' school for a long time, he came out from the countryside with a strong desire for the opposite sex.
However, when he arrived at the university, his lack of experience made it difficult for him to talk to woman, and he was unable to make proper contact with them.
Because of this, he was shunned by not only the opposite sex, but also by boys as well.
He used to have a positive and cheerful personality, but his continuous failures made him discouraged, and he became an inconspicuous and unobtrusive person at the university.
He was an unattractive man with immense desires.
However, his life changes drastically when he suddenly acquires the ability to control perception.

Taking advantage of being able to do as he pleased without anyone noticing, he became accustomed to the opposite sex by breaking into the homes of women close at hand, peeping into their lives and playing sexual pranks on them, acquiring practical knowledge of the female body in the process.
Overcoming his difficulties gave him confidence, and he regained his former positive personality.

Translated from https://dlsoft.dmm.co.jp/detail/bishop_0061/
